title: /data page: search, sort, grouping and filters are lost after opening a record (not kept in the address)
body:
repo:objectstack#7 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jTeURPvEm465RcoYEC

Found by the f7-shell area's dev while measuring #36299 (os-dev-report 7077650228 on #36299, which closes as premise refuted: /data has no page number to lose). Filed by the seat.

## What happens

The /data page keeps none of its list state in the address. A search is lost after opening and closing a record (measured). Sort, grouping and the Filter panel are lost the same way (read from code). ObjectView keeps them in `uf__search` / `uf__sort` / `uf__group` / `uf__filter` / `uf__page`.

## Design point to settle first

/data's address conditions are `filter[...]`, while ObjectView's panel is `uf__filter`. Decide how the two coexist (one spelling, or both, with which one winning) before code. If it is a product call, the seat brings it to the maintainer.

## To do

1. Keep search, sort, grouping and the Filter panel of /data in the address with the same keys ObjectView uses, reconciled with `filter[...]` per the design point.
2. Pin it: search, open a record, close it, and the search is still applied.

## Acceptance

- On /data, a search, sort, grouping or filter survives opening and closing a record and a page reload.

## Grade
p2 · area:ux · domain:ui. Every /data user loses their search on each record open; the workaround is to retype it.
